content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user with an existing task","i_want":"to update the task's fields in an edit form and see the saved result only after the backend confirms it","so_that":"I can keep my task list accurate","business_description":"Users can change an existing task. The edit form reuses the create form. Titles must be non-empty and at most 100 characters. Due Date cannot be earlier than the Creation Date. The frontend shows success or error messages after each update, and never shows a successful state before the backend confirms the update. The backend returns clear errors for a missing task, invalid input, missing mandatory fields and internal or database failures.","business_value":"Users can correct task details without deleting and recreating tasks, and the displayed data always matches what the backend has stored.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"An existing task with a valid title and a Due Date not earlier than its Creation Date","when":"The user opens the edit form, changes the title to a non-empty value of 100 characters or fewer, and submits the form","then":"The backend stores the new title and returns success, and only after that response the task shows the new title in the list"},{"given":"An update request is pending and the backend has not yet responded","when":"The user is waiting after submitting the edit form","then":"No success message is shown and the task list shows the old values for that task"},{"given":"An existing task being edited in the form","when":"The user clears the title field and submits the form","then":"The backend rejects the update with a missing mandatory field error, the stored title is unchanged, and the message \"Title is mandatory\" is shown"},{"given":"An existing task being edited in the form","when":"The user enters a title of 101 characters and submits the form","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored title is unchanged, and an error message stating the 100-character limit is shown"},{"given":"An existing task with Creation Date 2024-05-10","when":"The user sets the Due Date to 2024-05-09 and submits the update","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored Due Date is unchanged, and an error message is shown"},{"given":"A task update request where the backend returns an error","when":"The frontend receives the error response","then":"The frontend does not show the task as updated, keeps the form values for correction, and displays an error message"},{"given":"A task update request where the backend returns success","when":"The frontend receives the success response","then":"The frontend displays a success message after the update action"},{"given":"A task ID that does not exist in the database","when":"An update request is sent for that ID","then":"The backend returns a Task Not Found error and no data is changed"},{"given":"An update request with a malformed body or a field of the wrong type","when":"The backend receives the request","then":"The backend returns an invalid input error and no data is changed"},{"given":"An update request where the database fails during the write","when":"The backend processes the request","then":"The backend returns an internal server error, the stored task is unchanged, and the frontend shows an error message"}],"edge_cases":["A Due Date equal to the Creation Date is valid, because the rule only rejects dates earlier than the Creation Date.","A title of exactly 100 characters is accepted; a title of 101 characters is rejected.","A title containing only spaces is not defined as empty by the PRD; the team must decide whether it is rejected (open question).","The PRD does not say what happens when two users or two browser tabs update the same task at the same time (open question).","The PRD does not say whether the Last Updated Date changes on each successful update; this story assumes it does because the field exists in the data model (open question).","The PRD does not define the exact wording of the success message; the wording is left to the team."],"dependencies":["US-create-task","US-view-task-list"],"definition_of_done":["PATCH or PUT endpoint for updating a task by ID exists and validates title (non-empty, at most 100 characters) and Due Date against Creation Date.","Each error case (Task Not Found, invalid input, missing title, validation error, database failure) returns a distinct, documented error response.","Edit form pre-fills existing values and reuses the create form component.","Frontend does not change the displayed task or show success until the backend returns success.","Frontend shows a success or error message after every update, and keeps form values on error.","Automated tests cover every acceptance criterion of this story and pass."]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"task-update-endpoint","title":"[BE] Add
